```{r, include = FALSE}

#Load packages & datasets
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)
library(magrittr)
library(pbkrtest)
library(xtable)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggthemes)
library(colf)
library(Metrics)
library(cowplot)


# behavioral data: infants 
exp1_infant_d <- read_csv(here("data/infants/exp1.csv"))
exp2_zoom_infant_d <- read_csv(here("data/infants/exp2_zoom.csv"))
exp2_lookit_infant_d <- read_csv(here("data/infants/exp2_lookit.csv"))
exp2_control_infant_d <- read_csv(here("data/infants/exp2_control.csv"))

# behavioral data: adults 
exp1_adult_d <- read_csv(here("data/adults/adult_exposure_duration.csv"))
exp2_adult_d <- read_csv(here("data/adults/adult_stimuli_type.csv"))

# exp1 crossvalidation 
infant_resnet50_EIG_CV <- read_csv(here('data/infants/crossvalidation/resnet50_EIG_CV.csv'))
infant_resnet50_KL_CV <- read_csv(here('data/infants/crossvalidation/resnet50_KL_CV.csv'))
infant_resnet50_nolearning_CV <- read_csv(here('data/infants/crossvalidation/resnet50_nolearning_CV.csv'))
infant_resnet50_nonoise_CV <- read_csv(here('data/infants/crossvalidation/resnet50_nonoise_CV.csv'))
infant_resnet50_surprisal_short_CV <- read_csv(here('data/infants/crossvalidation/resnet50_surprisal_short_CV.csv'))

adult_kfold_resnet50_eig <- readRDS(here("data/adults/kfold_fit/adult_kfold_resnet50_eig.Rds")) %>% mutate(mean_rmse = mean_rmse/1000)
adult_kfold_resnet50_kl <- readRDS(here("data/adults/kfold_fit/adult_kfold_resnet50_kl.Rds")) %>% mutate(mean_rmse = mean_rmse/1000)
adult_kfold_resnet50_surprisal <- readRDS(here("data/adults/kfold_fit/adult_kfold_resnet50_surprisal.Rds")) %>% mutate(mean_rmse = mean_rmse/1000)
adult_kfold_resnet50_nolearning <- readRDS(here("data/adults/kfold_fit/adult_kfold_resnet50_nolearning.Rds")) %>% mutate(mean_rmse = mean_rmse/1000)
adult_kfold_resnet50_nonoise <- readRDS(here("data/adults/kfold_fit/adult_kfold_resnet50_nonoise.Rds")) %>% mutate(mean_rmse = mean_rmse/1000)


# exp1 full data comparison 

infant_fulldata_resnet50_eig <- read_csv(here("data/infants/full_data_fit/infants_fulldata_resnet50_EIG.csv"))
infant_fulldata_resnet50_kl <- read_csv(here("data/infants/full_data_fit/infants_fulldata_resnet50_KL.csv"))
infant_fulldata_resnet50_surprisal <- read_csv(here("data/infants/full_data_fit/infants_fulldata_resnet50_surprisal.csv"))
infant_fulldata_resnet50_nolearning <- read_csv(here("data/infants/full_data_fit/infants_fulldata_resnet50_nolearning.csv"))
infant_fulldata_resnet50_nonoise <- read_csv(here("data/infants/full_data_fit/infants_fulldata_resnet50_nonoise.csv"))


adult_fulldata_resnet50_eig <- readRDS(here("data/adults/full_data_fit/adult_fulldata_resnet50_eig.Rds"))
adult_fulldata_resnet50_kl <- readRDS(here("data/adults/full_data_fit/adult_fulldata_resnet50_kl.Rds"))
adult_fulldata_resnet50_surprisal <- readRDS(here("data/adults/full_data_fit/adult_fulldata_resnet50_surprisal.Rds"))
adult_fulldata_resnet50_nolearning <- readRDS(here("data/adults/full_data_fit/adult_fulldata_resnet50_nolearning.Rds"))
adult_fulldata_resnet50_nonoise <- readRDS(here("data/adults/full_data_fit/adult_fulldata_resnet50_nonoise.Rds"))
```
